board: Green HX711 load cell amplifier module (J2: GND, DT, SCK, VCC; J1: E+, E-, A-, A+, B-, B+) with 5 kg bar load cell
reason: Modelled from the Avia HX711 datasheet: DOUT-low ready, 24-bit two's-complement MSB-first readout with 25/26/27 PD_SCK pulses selecting A128/B32/A64, 60 us power-down, 400 ms settling; load slider in grams at 2^31*1mV/V/5000 g = 429.5 counts/g (ratiometric). Header order GND, DT, SCK, VCC from the vendor pinout diagram and product photo silkscreen. Part check printed PASS on ESP32 and Pico (tare then W=1250g, W=3700g; PCB DRC clean).
breakoutPinoutSource: https://shillehtek.com/blogs/shillehtek-product-manuals/hx711-weighing-pressure-sensor-module-large-presoldered-manual (pinout image https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0837/4340/8415/files/hx711-pinout.png?v=1776722625 and product photo silkscreen: J2 = GND, DT, SCK, VCC)
